data.raw_text:
Bangalore life hack.

For couple of years,  I travelled to Bengaluru every single week Wednesday to Saturday. Loved the weather, but hated the traffic. Particularly in evening and way back to the airport.

It was so disheartening to discover India's #1 tech hub had such pathetic traffic and narrow roads.

I soon discovered a life hack. 

Rather than going for meetings to all the tech hubs, I started inviting folks I needed to meet for meal and drinks to city center/UB City which used to be very near to my hotel or to Indira Nagar [bit far].

I was very generous - but in reality I was saving on travel time, trading off money for lots of time saved.

Used to stay at ITC Gardenia or Ritz, as wanted to be closer to Cuban park. Absolutely loved going to Cuban park everyday.

That is how used to motivate myself to travel from Mumbai every week. It was torture otherwise. 

I do not dread travelling any other city, as I used to dread travelling to Bangalore. The only other city I dread to travel that much is Manila. 

Jakarta has some traffic, but central Jakarta is a great place. Bengaluru has no such redeeming feature that was developed post independence.
